guide.absmod.page.1:
Welcome!

Craft this guide with a book + raw cod. Use it in air to read. Use it on cats to observe. Open vanilla Advancements for your next goal.
guide.absmod.page.2:
First blades

Normal: diamond sword + 4 separate amethyst shards + raw cod + pink dye.
Dark: netherite sword + 4 separate crying obsidian + purple dye.
guide.absmod.page.3:
Resonance

Craft a heart: 4 amethyst shards + gold ingot + pink dye. Use it. Sword goes in the first slot; materials go in the remaining top row. Click the heart once. Reopen for the next stage.
guide.absmod.page.4:
Normal 2-4

2: affection 10; 8 shards, 8 copper.
3: affection 25; 2 diamonds, 16 lapis.
4: affection 45; 4 amethyst blocks, 4 ender pearls.
guide.absmod.page.5:
Normal 5-6

5: affection 70; 4 diamonds, 4 blaze rods.
6: affection 100; 2 ghast tears, 4 phantom membranes, 8 amethyst blocks.
guide.absmod.page.6:
Normal 7-9

7: affection 140; 16 chorus fruit, 2 shulker shells, 4 diamonds.
8: affection 190; nether star, heart of the sea.
9: NOT OPEN. The soul-bound boss trial is not implemented.
guide.absmod.page.7:
Dark 2-4

2: affection 5; 8 obsidian.
3: affection 12; 8 gold ingots, 2 blaze rods.
4: affection 22; 8 crying obsidian.
guide.absmod.page.8:
Dark 5-8

5: affection 35; 2 ghast tears.
6: affection 50; 2 netherite scraps.
7: affection 70; 8 blaze rods, 8 pearls.
8: affection 100; netherite ingot. This is the final dark stage.
guide.absmod.page.9:
Combat

Hold attack to slash. Normal blades build combos on valid hits. Dark blades do not. Dark heavy strike: default G, rebindable; 0.6s windup, 8s cooldown. Switching weapons or opening a menu cancels preparation.
guide.absmod.page.10:
Your spirit

Sneak-use your held blade to manifest. A spectral link remains. Sneak-use your own spirit to recall. Attack with the link to auto-recall. Recall before upgrading. Spirits are invulnerable.
guide.absmod.page.11:
Affection

Each game day: talk +1; raw-cod gift +2; active following +1 per 5 min (max 4); 10 distinct hostile hits +1 (max 4). Upgrade gates do not spend affection. Sitting online alone is not active following.
guide.absmod.page.12:
Repair

A broken blade remains but cannot attack. Use an anvil: diamond for normal, netherite for dark. Mending works. Combining two soul blades is blocked to protect identities. Close resonance to recover your inputs.
guide.absmod.page.13:
Cat collecting

Find village cats and tame with raw fish. Use this guide on a cat to read its dilution genes and generation. Your existing cats keep their looks. Genes stay saved across reloads.
guide.absmod.page.14:
A hidden color

DD: dense color.
Dd: hidden dilution carrier.
dd: dilute.
Each parent passes one allele. Dd x Dd gives a 25% dilute chance per kitten, not a promise that every fourth kitten is dilute.
guide.absmod.page.15:
Plan a pairing

Sneak-use the guide on the first cat; use it on a second nearby cat to predict dilution. Tame both, let them stand and feed fish to breed. Observe the kitten for lineage and collection advancements.
guide.absmod.page.16:
Prototype limits

Only dilution follows Mendelian genetics here. Pattern choice is a game approximation. Black dilute cats appear blue-gray; other dilute textures are pending. No sex restriction or disease simulation. FTB files await a compatible runtime.
